versions.content: If bandwidth limitation is realized by FlowControl parameter BC and if the attribute “FrTpBandwidthLimitation“ is True, a Start Frame to initiate a communication link shall always be send in the first PDU of the referenced PDU - Pool. This is valid for both 1: 1 and 1:n connections. Note: The reason for using the first frame of the pool in case of bandwidth limitation is historical. Bandwidth limitation is only required for FlexRay controllers with a limited number of buffers, which are then assigned to the fir st slots of the pool (the ones with the lowest numbers).
